name: S3.3 failure normalizer golden set
description: Build Bible §22 evaluation dataset, v1: 30 broken-test failure texts with known root causes — the S3.3 exit gate (§19: 30 broken tests normalize 100%). Each fixture is raw Playwright failure text (message + snippet, the shape of TestResultReport.error) with the expected §16 taxonomy category and the structured fields the normalizer must extract (http_status, selector, endpoint, decisive signals). Consumed by the S3.3 unit tests (tests/unit/test_failure.py) and the CLI golden mode (python -m qa_copilot_execution.failure --golden); S4.1 (Failure Investigator, AI) will score its top-1 classification on the same texts (>= 80%, §31.7).
